contact_definition.method: minimum selected heavy-atom distance per residue pair
contact_definition.interpretation: geometric proximity; not hydrogen bonds, affinity, or energetic hotspots

representation.interface: contact-residue sticks with coordinate-derived covalent geometry
representation.surface_method: Gaussian atomic density isosurface; not a solvent-excluded surface

warnings: Omitted solvent: water residues are recorded but water-mediated contacts are not inferred.
No secondary-structure representation is supplied; surfaces are illustrative atomic envelopes, not solvent-excluded surfaces.
